error.message: This IDA request reached the registration timeoutMs deadline of 1800000 ms (deadlineExpired).

remediation.action: Set timeoutMs in the JSON file named by REA_IDA_MCP_CONFIG to an integer from 1 to 2147483647 (omitted means 300000). REA applies the edited file on the next IDA connection after it re-reads the registration; an already open session keeps the timeout it connected with. Allow execution, cleanup and delivery headroom in the outer MCP client deadline. Confirm outstanding work and cleanup before retrying.

diagnostics.reason: IDA cleanup could not be verified; the remaining connection or private workspace is retained for retry.
diagnostics.failure_reason: IDA database open did not return a completed response. Worker inventory cannot prove that the request has stopped; the private workspace was retained.

upstream_sessions.reason: Release of upstream sessions matching the requested session ID or private input was not confirmed; input_path preserves the last observed binding and is null when no inventory has reported it. is_active preserves registry activity and is null when unknown; it does not establish process liveness. A worker outlives its supervisor and may keep running until it finishes and reaches its idle timeout; exiting REA does not stop it. A gui session belongs to an IDA instance REA does not control. An empty session_id means upstream reported none; owned is null when no inventory has reported ownership; an empty list means the requested worker's close was confirmed but no inventory has identified any remaining session.

details.cleanup_reason: IDA connection or private workspace cleanup remains unverified.

post_timeout_cleanup_verification.scope: Post-timeout inventory; does not turn failed REA close into a successful close observation.
